g.text: Seller Application and Administrator Review Activity
Fill shop, owner identity, bank account
Load User, existing applications and seller record
Load pending queue or application history/details
Already APPROVED or User already seller?
Create ACTIVE Seller from shop details
Notifications are conditional on service presence.
There is no edit/resubmit endpoint for an existing application.
REJECTED/NEED_MORE_DOC permits a new submission only while
the customer has no PENDING/APPROVED application or seller record.
Reject/request-docs have no prior-status guard; approval may start
